name: click-on-the-go
description: Wix Product Capture — foto → IA (Gemini) → Neon → Blob → Wix Catalog V3 (UPSERT por SKU)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @click-on-the-go/backend" "npm run dev -w @click-on-the-go/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @click-on-the-go/shared && npm run build -w @click-on-the-go/backend && npm run build -w @click-on-the-go/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @click-on-the-go/shared && npm run typecheck -w @click-on-the-go/backend && npm run typecheck -w @click-on-the-go/frontend
